description: Real-time weather + 3-day forecast. Returns current (temp_c, feels_like_c, humidity_pct, wind_kph, weather_code) and forecast_3d array. Pass location as city name ('Berlin') or GPS string ('52.52,13.41'). WMO codes: 0=clear, 1-3=cloudy, 45-48=fog, 51-67=rain, 71-77=snow, 95-99=thunderstorm. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"location":"Berlin"}.

location.description: City name (e.g. 'Berlin'), or lat,lon string (e.g. '52.52,13.41'). Default: Berlin

name: weather
title: Weather Data
